lane: exact claim-to-evidence provenance for scientific mapping witnesses

projections.projection: TextQuoteSelector and TextPositionSelector already provide exact quote/context and position-based targeting semantics.
projections.rakl_effect: Selector machinery is prior art; RAKL retains only evidence-governance constraints around immutable identity, chronology and authority.

projections.source: Can AI Validate Science? Benchmarking LLMs on Claim → Evidence Reasoning in AI Papers
projections.projection: More than 300 scientific claim-evidence pairs expose substantial model limitations and a multi-pass cost/accuracy tradeoff.
projections.rakl_effect: Do not assume semantic relation labels are reliable merely because a model found a passage.

projections.projection: Open-source biomedical sentence-level evidence extraction benchmark with human-validated evidence annotations.
projections.rakl_effect: Candidate real-corpus route for source-level versus exact-span versus reviewed-span ablations.

projections.source: PaperTrail: A Claim-Evidence Interface for Grounding Provenance in LLM-based Scholarly Q&A
projections.projection: Scholarly answer/source decomposition into claim-evidence units is already explicit prior art.
projections.rakl_effect: Granular scholarly provenance is not a RAKL novelty claim.

projections.source: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
projections.projection: Source ownership and pooled factual support are separable verification axes; joint source-plus-relation attribution can remain difficult.
projections.rakl_effect: Source/span identity must remain distinct from semantic evidence relation.

projections.source: ProvenAI: Provenance-Native Traces of Evidence in Generated Answers
projections.projection: Citation fidelity can be separated from behavioral document influence under intervention.
projections.rakl_effect: Round 030B does not infer that cited evidence causally influenced generation.

retained_rakl_objects: locator fidelity and semantic evidence relation are separate typed layers
exact source snapshot identity plus selector chronology fail closed on stale/post-hoc provenance
proposal-versus-reviewed support/refutation disagreement is preserved as negative history
neither exact span provenance nor reviewed relation grants target/scientific authority
